title: Growth Mobs
description: Growth Mobs adds powerful growth stages to Minecraft mobs, transforming ordinary enemies into massive bosses with unique abilities, custom boss bars, devastating attacks, and enormous health pools. Progress through new gear tiers.
body:
# Growth Mobs

What started as a simple idea quickly became complete chaos.

Growth Mobs adds powerful growth stages to Minecraft mobs using the Growth Pearl. Throw a Growth Pearl at supported mobs to increase their size, health, damage, abilities, and overall threat level. What begins as a slightly larger enemy can eventually become a colossal boss capable of destroying terrain and wiping out unprepared players.

## Growth Stages

Most supported mobs can evolve through multiple stages:

• Big
• Large
• Sub-Titan
• Titan

Each stage increases size, health, and power. Some mobs gain entirely new abilities as they grow.

## Enhanced Mobs

🧟 Zombie

The Zombie becomes a devastating melee powerhouse. Higher stages grant increased strength, larger health pools, and the powerful Stomp attack capable of creating explosions and craters.

☠ Skeleton

The Skeleton specializes in ranged destruction. As it grows, it gains multi-arrow attacks capable of launching entire barrages at its targets while retaining powerful stomp attacks.

❄ Stray

A frozen variant of the Skeleton that retains all of its ranged power while firing slowness arrows and surviving in daylight.

🔥 Blaze

The Blaze evolves into a living artillery platform. Large stages unlock Fireball Beams, while higher stages allow it to unleash multiple beams simultaneously alongside its normal attacks. It also possesses a devastating Fire Stomp.

💥 Creeper

Perhaps the most terrifying growth path. Bigger size means bigger explosions. Higher stages turn the Creeper into a walking catastrophe.

☠ Wither

The Wither follows a unique progression and caps at Large size. Despite this limitation, it gains dangerous abilities including block-stealing laser beams, blue skull projectile rings, and Wither Skeleton summoning.

## Ender Colossus

The ultimate challenge.

The Ender Colossus is not simply a stronger Titan. It is an entirely different level of threat. Massive health, overwhelming power, and battlefield-shattering abilities make it one of the strongest entities in the mod.

## Equipment Progression

As enemies become stronger, players gain access to powerful new materials.

Netherite
→ Enderium
→ Voidite
→ Astralite
→ Titanite

Each tier must be unlocked in order before the next can be obtained, creating a true endgame progression system.

## Creative-Only Materials

Some materials exist purely for testing, experimentation, and absolute nonsense.

• Harcadium
• Sillynium
• Googolplexinium

These materials can only be obtained through commands or Creative Mode.

Warning: Googolplexinium may cause nearby mobs to reconsider their life choices.

## Additional Features

📡 Size Radar

Scan nearby entities and identify their growth stages before engaging them.

⚔ Custom Mob Battles

Use commands to force mobs to attack each other and create massive boss battles.

⚙ Configurable Growth System

Growth values can be customized and expanded, allowing complete control over the progression system.

## Are You Ready?

Normal Minecraft teaches you how to fight Zombies.

Growth Mobs teaches Zombies how to fight back.
